gofmt reads a declaration's shape from the tree and spaces a field name from its type accordingly, and pads the name and type columns of a struct with its tabwriter. The emitter reads the token stream, so it cannot tell a struct field's type from an index expression, and `src/format/align.rs` aligns the two runs decision 10 of the plan names — assignments and trailing comments — rather than every tabwriter cell.

gofmt drops the spaces around the higher-precedence operator of a mixed expression, so `1 + 2*3` rather than `1 + 2 * 3`. The rule reads the expression's precedence tree, which the token-stream emitter does not build; every binary operator is spaced instead.
A pointer receiver `(h *Holder)` spaces its star as a type prefix rather than as a binary operator, which is a declaration-context call the token stream cannot make.
Every line of the type fixture is a struct field whose name and type are separated by a tabwriter column, and whose type spacing is read from the declaration's shape.
